contradictions.evidence_a_id: AMH 2026 Proxy: 'resident satisfaction numbers have never been higher' (E-122)
contradictions.resolution: T1 evidence (public complaints) overrides T1 self-reported internal metrics. Gap = internal vs external measurement. Score maintained at 1.81.

contradictions.evidence_b_id: Indeed 2.8/5, ALL wellbeing dimensions Low, 40% CEO approval (E-003)
contradictions.resolution: Indeed captures active employee experience more candidly; Glassdoor is candidate-facing. Score set at 1.94 per adverse evidence rule.

contradictions.evidence_b_id: Azure APIM + Kafka for integration lacks formal enterprise bus (gap E-077)
contradictions.resolution: Integration bus sub-capability (P4C3.3) scored at 3.0 despite overall architecture strength 3.95. No contradiction — sub-caps scored independently.

contradictions.evidence_a_id: CTO states 'Our technology has been deployed at scale' (E-013)
contradictions.evidence_b_id: No confirmation of BERT+LLM deployment in production scale beyond $10M savings claim (E-111)
contradictions.resolution: E-111 from earnings transcript (T1) provides sufficient evidence for M3.5 scoring. No contradiction — different capability aspects.

contradictions.evidence_a_id: Board letter states AMH has 'strong governance' (E-122)
contradictions.evidence_b_id: No PMO, no named IT steering committee, informal CTO-led IT governance
contradictions.resolution: Board-level governance (Audit Committee, HCC, NCG) is strong. IT governance specifically is informal. Score at 2.43 reflects IT governance gap, not board governance.
